stories.title: India news Live Updates, 21 September 2026: IMD orange alert for six Kerala districts as rains kill four, six swept away in Nilambur flash flood

en.title: India news Live Updates, 21 September 2026: IMD orange alert for six Kerala districts as rains kill four, six swept away in Nilambur flash flood
en.summary: Heavy rains in Kerala have caused four deaths and six people were swept away in a flash flood in Nilambur. The Indian Meteorological Department has issued an orange alert for six districts in the state.

stories.title: Mumbai student alleges home search after pro-Palestine campaign

en.title: Mumbai student alleges home search after pro-Palestine campaign
en.summary: A Mumbai student claims police conducted a nine-hour home search without a warrant following her participation in a pro-Palestine kite-flying campaign, during which she alleges friends were mistreated and she was detained.
